capabilities: Expand text shortcuts into longer replacement text via Ctrl/Cmd+Tab, command palette, or Tab/Space
Place the cursor after replacement using $end$
Insert line breaks in multiline snippets with $nl$
Add tabstops with $tb$ and jump between them when the shortcut finds no expansion
Select text to replace snippets containing spaces
extras: Live Preview requires enabling a toggle in plugin settings and restarting the plugin; when Tab is the shortcut, a normal Tab is only inserted if no expansion or tabstop jump applies.
intentEvidence: create your own snippets almost like in many text editors and IDE
problem: Obsidian has no built-in snippet system for expanding short text triggers into longer text while typing.
summary: Text snippet plugin that expands typed shortcuts into templates with cursor placement and tabstops for faster typing.
